_note: One entry per district Pukaar serves. Hand-kept, read by scripts/seed.py (never by code at run time: the seed copies each district's Hindi name and LGD code onto its villages' records, and the CAP feed reads them from there). lgd_code: the Local Government Directory (lgdirectory.gov.in) district code, the geocode SACHET's own CAP messages carry ('LGD District Code'); Himachal Pradesh is LGD state 2. Hamirpur 17 and Mandi 22 were checked against the LGD district list as mirrored by Google Data Commons (scripts/india_lgd) and the India Data Portal (district_lgd.csv). officers: the district's fallback approval chain (usernames, in call order) used for its villages on a production stage when no duty roster row covers the shift; empty until the DDMA names them. A dev stage gives every village the demo officers of villages.json instead. Add a district with scripts/add_village.py (docs/DEPLOY.md, 'Adding a village or a district').
